I felt the quality from the minute i started assembly, a good deal of extra feature improvements from my old classic weber. Love the smoking and slow cooking results after 2 weeks of owning the grill, searing a steak was so easy with the included charcoal baskets, happy with it all around, 
One disappointment though, the color is not accurately represented on the website. It looks gray more then anything else.

Results.ReviewText: I researched a bunch of grills from the pellet ones to gas. It came down to having versatile unit that can smoke and grill. The accessories that you can get for the kettle grill can be used for multiple cooking methods. I am very happy with my master touch and would recommend it for anyone starting out on their BBQ journey. Cheers to you and Happy Grilling!!!

Results.ReviewText: Very very happy with my purchase, the versatility, quality construction, ease of cleaning far outshine other grills I’ve had before. Just need to pick up a pizza stone and maybe a wok and I’ll be set.

Results.ReviewText: Be careful assembling the grill. I used the plastic tool provided to attach the handle on the lid and didn’t tighten past snug. The coating on the outside of the lid cracked badly and exposed the metal underneath. I sent info with pictures to customer service and never received a response. Worried the lid will weather quickly with the exposed material, and it looks pretty rough around the handle. Disappointed in the material, the grill works as expected and has been nice to use. I would recommend the mid-level kettle over the master-touch.
Results.Title: Be careful assembling

Results.ReviewText: I’ve been a loyal Weber fan and user for over 40 years. One, I like the fact that it’s taller than my previous kettles (not getting any younger you know). The durability, I’m not just a casual user, I use the heck out of them all year long. I cater several events and always bring my Weber. Now that I have the green one it’s a show stopper.

Results.ReviewText:
This is a great grill.  I upgraded from a basic 22" kettle because I was tired of the ash storm everytime I cleaned out the bottom of the grill.  The ash catcher is as good as I'd hoped and is going to cut down on the dusty mess all over my deck.  The added height of this grill is also nice, it's maybe 2 inches taller than a standard kettle.  The insulated handles for the lid and the lid vent are nice because they could get so hot on my old one.  The addition of a thermometer is a game changer.  Really nice to have.  There's one thing I do not like and it's the Gourmet Barbecue System grate.  It's heavy!  Heavier than the standard hinged grate, and definitely heavier than the basic unhinged one.  It's hinged on the sides which is nice but the center is a separate piece that is not secured in any way.  If you are accustomed to hanging your grate on the handle or side of grill while you light the coals you're going to have problems.  The center will fall right out.  And if you actually use your grill frequently the the center is going to get very black and very gunky and touching it with bare hands is going to be a mess.  Setting it down on something is going to make a mess.  Anything you do with this center piece is going to make a mess.  And even if it doesn't you're going to have to try and fit this thing in the center of the rest of the grate potentially over the hottest section of your fire.  
If they really wanted us to buy in on the Gourmet Barbecue System they should've included 1 or 2 of the inserts to demonstrate the benefits of the system with this $250 grill.  Instead they've given you a grate with a hole in the middle with no added benefits unless you want to plunk down between $45 and $65 a piece for the inserts.  In the end I bought myself a new standard hinged grate and will be happy with that.  
Oh and if you're assembling this thing please open the plastic bag that contains the lid handle.  The handle is the last thing you put on if you follow the directions but the wrench you need to do all the nuts in earlier steps is also in this bag.  Bad decision Weber.
Results.Title: I like everything about this grill except the GBS

The second and more important has to do with a broken weld on the grill grate. This is more problematic and appears to be worsening as the other side may be weakening with use. I noticed the issue on the second time I used the grill.

Results.ReviewText: Works great but could use some improvements. It is a shame that the thermometer is still on the opposite side of the vent on the hood. This places the thermometer directly above the fire and not where the food is making it useless. The vent should also be on a flat surface of the hood to allow it to make a better seal. For a grill over $200 the quality should be better and these minor but obvious modifications should have been addressed.

Results.ReviewText: Love love this grill! I live in an apartment so I always used an electric grill because with charcoal grills, you have to be 25’ away from your apartment. I never was that happy with the flavor and I love smoked meat. I finally decided to buy this Weber grill and move it away from my apartment when using it. Sooo happy with my decision. It’s soo easy to use, I use a Weber chimney to get my charcoal ready & I put them in the 2 charcoal baskets to smoke ribs, chicken etc. I’ll never go back to electric or gas.

Results.ReviewText: We love Weber grills and this was the second one we’ve purchased. But one of the pieces came damaged. I’ve registered the grill and filed a claim for a replacement piece and haven’t heard anything back at all. It is very frustrating!
Results.Title: Good grill but bad warranty

Results.ReviewText: Love my master touch. A few years ago I had an old gas grill that needed replacing and I switched to charcoal and now I’ll never switch back!  The master touch has been great and we do quick cooks like steaks and burgers etc but we also smoke ribs, brisket and pulled pork. It works great for slow cooking chicken too. Also very important to add - I did have a problem with my kettle in that part of the bowl had broken and began to sag. But Weber replaced it for free and within 48 hours my new bowl arrived. They even sent me new legs for free as well even though technically they were out of warranty. What amazing customer service. I’ll be a Weber owner for life based on that experience.
Results.Title: Great product Great customer service

Results.ReviewText: Bought this because the Deep Ocean Blue color reminded me of an old Harley I used  to ride around on 40 years ago. This is my second Master Touch and it's just as nice as the first one I purchased 4 years ago. Recieved it just in time for Memorial Day and have already done two grills on it. Ribeye steaks and nice fatty hamburgers. Found the P shaped vents made using lump charcoal easier to damp down so it doesn't over heat. A very nice mod to an already gret grill. Was pleased to see the warming rack was included, although not mentioned in the discription. Nice grill,  will donate first one to one of the kids.
Results.Title: Top notch, as always

14501001.Name: 22” Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill
14501001.Description: Some things never go out of style—like the smoky flavor of charcoal, the sizzle of a summer cookout, and the iconic silhouette of the 22" Master-Touch™ Charcoal Grill. This grill features a handy Tuck-Away Lid Holder that gives you a convenient place to nest the lid against the side of the bowl, a hinged cooking grate that fits circular GBS accessories so you can explore more ways to cook, a built-in lid thermometer, and legs that are 2” taller than standard kettles. Like all Weber® kettles, it’s built to last with a porcelain-enameled bowl and lid that retain heat and resist rust, peeling, and scratching, and adjustable lid and bowl dampers to fine-tune the heat for perfect results. When it’s time to clean up, the One-Touch™ cleaning system makes it neat and effortless—just swipe the lever to clear ashes into the enclosed, high-capacity ash catcher. Two wheels make it easy to roll this timeless classic to the center of the action, right where it belongs.
